Verify Now Blog > Explore the PCBWay Brochure to Learn About Our Capabilities Explore the PCBWay Brochure to Learn About Our Capabilities by: Mila Mar 25,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in News What’s Inside the Brochure? This document provides a structured overview of PCB manufacturing and assembly capabilities, making it easier for engineers and sourcing teams to make informed decisions. You’ll find detailed information on: PCB Types & Technologies: Including multilayer PCBs, HDI boards, rigid-flex, and advanced structures Manufacturing Capabilities: Line width/spacing, minimum drill size, copper thickness, and board thickness Materials & Surface Finishes: FR4, high-frequency materials, ENIG, HASL, and more PCB Assembly (PCBA) Services: Turnkey assembly, component sourcing, and testing capabilities Quality Standards & Certifications: Designed to meet industrial-grade and high-reliability requirements Why Download This Brochure? Instead of searching through scattered information or going back and forth with technical questions, this brochure helps you: Quickly evaluate whether your design meets manufacturing capabilities Understand key process limitations early in the design stage Streamline supplier selection Improve communication efficiency and reduce iteration cycles It’s a practical reference for both design and sourcing decisions.
